simple.summary: דָּן יַעַן (Dân Yaʻan) means Dan-Jaan , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Sam 24 6.

definitions.full: H1842. Dan Yaan II. יַעַן in יַעַן דַּנָֿה 2Sam 24:6 see above. יען (√ of following; according to Ges Ew GGA 1864, No. 27 Aramaic , avidus, cupidus ; hence יַעֲנָה בַּת = daughter of greed , of ostrich as voracious bird; but Wetzst Del Job 31:39 = daughter of the desert or steppe , from hard, unproductive soil ; compare the Arabic name father of the plains. )
